unreachable.reason: No program includes it, and the name appears in no other file in the tree. It describes a user record with a clear-text password field. Safe to propose for deletion, but provisional: telemetry is none and the extractor reads only COPY and INCLUDE statements.

unknown.reason: Kept in unknown, as the validator requires. Nothing in the tree names it: no JCL step, no CSD entry, no scheduler and no menu table. The 28 computed calls in reachable code are all CICS transfers. The two menu tables bound the table-driven ones to 17 named online programs and the rest move literal screen names, so none can reach a batch program. Its six DDs are mapped by no JCL step. That points to dead code, but only telemetry or the client can say it never runs. It reads the daily transaction file and the masters, so it may be an older validation pass before CBTRN02C. Do not delete on this evidence.

Named only in JCL text held inside a COBOL literal.
